title: Workspace outbound access protection for Azure and Fabric events (Preview)

content.text: Workspace outbound access protection (OAP) for Azure and Fabric events (Preview) extends outbound network controls to cross-workspace event consumption. For more information, see Tenant private links for Azure and Fabric events.
